transcript.text: Tell me about a time you improved a system under pressure.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: The situation was that our checkout API was timing out during a Diwali sale. My task was to find the cause and stabilize it within the day. I led the on-call response, profiled the slow path, identified a missing index on the orders table, and shipped a hotfix. The result was p99 latency dropped from 4.2s to 380ms within 6 hours, and we recovered roughly 18 lakhs in pending checkouts.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Good. Tell me about a time you influenced without authority.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Context: our partner team owned the payments service and wouldn't prioritize a retry change. My responsibility was to unblock 12 dependent services. I built a prototype showing 30% fewer false declines, walked it through a design review with their tech lead, and proposed splitting ownership of the retry policy. The outcome was the change shipped in 3 weeks and false declines dropped 28% across all merchants.
